QA-100887 is a PASS. All five Threads values match between Brand Insights and Time Window Comparison for Dec 6–12, 2024, on Authorized data for UCLA:

| Metric | Insights | TWC |
|---|---|---|
| Follower Growth / New Followers | 13 | 13 |
| New Posts / Posts | 9 | 9 |
| Engagements | 369 | 369 |
| Engagement Rate | 2.52% | 2.52% |
| Views | 14,635 | 14,635 |

The case had no open linked bugs, and no known bug interfered. I didn't file anything.

One slip during the run: after I picked the start date in Time Window Comparison, the end calendar jumped to Oct 2026 and my first "12" click set Oct 12, 2026. I caught it in the screenshot, paged the end calendar back to Dec 2024 and re-picked the day before running the report. The report logs this with the date-picker selector notes.

The report is at `results/2026-10-27/QA-100887-report.md`, and screenshots are in `.playwright-out/QA-100887/`.
